Title: App Translations
Description: Let editors change the text in your next-intl or i18next application from the Umbraco backoffice, without a code change or a deploy.

Screenshots.Caption: Edit any message against another language, with its placeholders highlighted and the application's default text beside it.
Add the sources Umbraco reads your application's messages from, and copy the delivery URL for each language.
Point a source at your translation files, choose the languages it supplies, and the message syntax it uses.
